requirementChecks.criteria: Read the original file properties: Format: presentation document; at least eight actual pages. Stage: final.

The sheet occupies one page and states field priorities, placement by carrier, font families, weights and minimum type sizes for all three carriers. It assigns Tide Foxes/TFX to #C84919, Basalt Owls/BOW to #5D3A75, Copper Deer/CDE to #007C73 and Frost Kites/FKA to #2663A4. It specifies the competition title, FINAL SCORE, CHAMPIONS and PTS/REB/AST. It records square 1:1, story 9:16 and arena 16:9 proportions, with 5% insets on every square and arena edge and story insets of 5% at the sides and 12% at the top and bottom. Organization is flexible; missing carrier specifications, incorrect mappings or unstated minimum sizes fail.

Every static application displays the competition title and uses the hierarchy sheet's correct team-to-colour assignments in its badges. Applications need not print hexadecimal codes. Carrier-specific arrangements and the permitted title styling may vary; an omitted title, swapped team colour or recoloured badge fails. Motion is evaluated separately.

The presentation explicitly reproduces the correct four hexadecimal team colour codes and their team associations, the competition title, all three carrier proportions, and the square/arena 5% and story 5% side/12% vertical safe areas. The competition title appears on its cover. These facts may appear in readable reused specification artwork or presentation text; omissions or contradictions fail.

Read each role against its named match. SF1 must show Semifinal 1, 22 May 2027, scheduled start 10:00 UTC+01:00, Tide Foxes 72 with quarters 18/16/20/18 and Basalt Owls 68 with 15/18/17/18. SF2 must show Semifinal 2, 22 May 2027, scheduled start 12:00 UTC+01:00, Copper Deer 61 with 14/15/16/16 and Frost Kites 65 with 17/16/14/18. BRZ must show Bronze match, 23 May 2027, scheduled start 15:00 UTC+01:00, Basalt Owls 70 with 20/17/16/17 and Copper Deer 62 with 13/18/15/16. FINAL must show Final, 23 May 2027, scheduled start 18:00 UTC+01:00, Tide Foxes 77 with 17/20/18/22 and Frost Kites 74 with 20/16/19/19. Each graphic also includes its match ID, Quarry Court, FINAL SCORE, full team names and matching badges. Quarters must be labelled Q1–Q4 and associated with the correct team; values are individual-quarter points, not cumulative totals. Team order and date typography may vary if meaning remains unambiguous. Missing fields, incorrect values, an unlabelled scheduled start or a score assigned to the wrong team fail.

The arena artwork identifies Tide Foxes and Frost Kites with their matching badges and assigns them 77 and 74 respectively. It includes labelled Q1–Q4 sequences of 17/20/18/22 for Tide Foxes and 20/16/19/19 for Frost Kites, 23 May 2027, a scheduled start identified as 18:00 UTC+01:00, Quarry Court and FINAL SCORE. Spatial arrangement and date formatting may vary; missing context, incorrect quarter association or reversed score ownership fail.

The story identifies Tide Foxes and Frost Kites with their matching badges, assigns the 77–74 result to those teams correctly, and includes 23 May 2027, a scheduled start identified as 18:00 UTC+01:00, Quarry Court and FINAL SCORE. Layout and equivalent date formatting may vary. Missing or incorrect required fields fail; quarter scores are not required on this carrier.

Trace both semifinal outcomes: SF1 sends Tide Foxes to the Final and Basalt Owls to Bronze; SF2 sends Frost Kites to the Final and Copper Deer to Bronze. The four matches retain the correct team-owned scores: SF1 TFX 72/BOW 68, SF2 CDE 61/FKA 65, Bronze BOW 70/CDE 62 and Final TFX 77/FKA 74. Finishing positions are explicitly first Tide Foxes, second Frost Kites, third Basalt Owls and fourth Copper Deer, with CHAMPIONS beside Tide Foxes. Bracket direction and connector style may vary; ambiguous advancement, missing matches, wrong scores or incorrect placings fail.

Each named role contains its own player: Mara Vale, jersey 9, Tide Foxes/TFX, FINAL, 28 PTS/7 REB/5 AST; Inez Rowan, jersey 12, Frost Kites/FKA, FINAL, 24 PTS/8 REB/4 AST; Suri Chen, jersey 4, Basalt Owls/BOW, BRZ, 23 PTS/5 REB/6 AST; Nola Reed, jersey 21, Copper Deer/CDE, BRZ, 19 PTS/9 REB/3 AST. Both FINAL cards also display Tide Foxes 77–74 Frost Kites, and both BRZ cards display Basalt Owls 70–62 Copper Deer, using full names and matching badges for both teams. Statistics must retain their labels and named-match association. Capitalization, line wrapping and field arrangement may vary; a duplicated player, omitted player, wrong jersey, swapped statistic or mismatched game context fails.

Player identity and sporting performance are presented through typography and graphic elements, with the statistics visibly associated with the stated match. Graphic motifs and typographic emphasis are open design choices. Substituting an athlete-portrait treatment for the requested typography-and-graphics treatment, or presenting the numbers as tournament totals, fails.

The nine square applications have equal width and height, the static story uses a 9:16 carrier and the arena artwork uses 16:9. All text and badge bounds remain within the inner 90% of square and arena width and height; story text and badges remain within the inner 90% of width and 76% of height. Decorative backgrounds may extend outside these insets. Compare font families, weights, field priorities, carrier placement and minimum type sizes with the hierarchy sheet at the relevant carrier scale. Carrier-specific reflow is allowed; wrong proportions, protected content crossing an inset or a visible departure from the stated typography specifications fails.

Each displayed team name has an unambiguous association with its correct supplied mark: Tide Foxes/TFX/#C84919, Basalt Owls/BOW/#5D3A75, Copper Deer/CDE/#007C73 and Frost Kites/FKA/#2663A4. Preserve full-name spelling and the mark's silhouette, internal geometry, code and colours. Uniform resizing and removal of surrounding white fields are permitted, as are name capitalization and line wrapping. A badge swap, distorted geometry, rewritten code, recolouring or missing corresponding badge fails.

Review the entire 10-second video. The complete approved static story is continuously visible in the opening 0–2-second and closing 8–10-second holds, including the title, FINAL SCORE, both correctly paired team names and badges, Tide Foxes 77–74 Frost Kites, 23 May 2027, scheduled start 18:00 UTC+01:00 and Quarry Court. The intervening section animates existing story content; animation technique is flexible. The competition title remains visible throughout. The video retains the 9:16 carrier, correct badge identities and colours, hierarchy-sheet typography and minimum sizes, and 5% side/12% top-and-bottom safe areas for all text and badges throughout motion. Incorrect duration, incomplete holds, substituted facts, absent animation, disappearance of the title or protected content crossing an inset fails.
requirementChecks.manualReason: Inspect complete SHA-bound original outputs. This source draft contains no completed professional or model-output review; partial-frame/page sampling cannot prove whole-output compliance.

requirementChecks.criteria: The presentation visibly incorporates the delivered hierarchy sheet, each of the four distinct result graphics, the completed bracket, all four distinct player cards, the arena artwork, the static story and frames from the delivered animation. Scaling and page composition may vary, but each source must remain identifiable and its relevant content readable. A textual mention without visible reuse, an omitted source, substituted artwork or unrelated video frames fails.

Count at least eight pages and inspect a fact-location map that identifies the applications carrying the four match results, advancement and finishing positions, and the four players' match statistics. Entries name the relevant deliverables and actual presentation page numbers, and those pages contain the stated facts. The map may use a table, index or annotations; missing fact categories, vague references without deliverable names or page numbers, and incorrect page references fail.

Treat line breaks, capitalization changes and a typographic apostrophe as permitted presentations of the fixed competition title. This diagnostic records an explicit allowance and does not impose an additional failure condition.

The static applications implement the hierarchy sheet's field priorities, carrier placement and typography as one publishing system, allowing layouts to adapt to results, advancement, player statistics and carrier shape. The competition title and team identity mappings agree across the static applications and with the hierarchy sheet. Square and arena text and badges respect 5% edge insets, while story text and badges respect 5% side and 12% top and bottom insets.
